known_outcome: Determination (20 Nov 2024, s 188, §6.1, p.10): there is insufficient information to establish compliance with C4 of the proposed alteration to the means of escape from fire by adding internal door locks. Reasoning: the classified use is communal residential (§4.11, p.7); C4.3(a) and C4.5 are the applicable performance criteria (p.7); the locks cannot be assessed on their own and need an alternative-solution demonstration of the building's overall means of escape (§4.16, p.8); there is insufficient evidence to determine compliance (§4.25, p.9).
review_focus: Whether the answer identifies C4.2 and C4.5 and treats the A1 classified-use question as the threshold.
Whether it notes that a design guide was used as the framework and what alternative-solution evidence was missing.
Whether it asks for lock-type, resident-capability and fire-engineer scope evidence.
Whether it treats the decision as insufficient information, not a finding that the locks fail.
Whether it does not say the locks comply.
instruction: Do not upload this file with the test prompt. Published outcome is not a new technical approval or a complete scored ground truth.
